reexport_blocker.error: AssertionError: All tensors must have the same rank
reexport_blocker.cause: Moonshine's third conv yields a rank-4 tensor and the legacy tracer rejects the mixed-rank stack. Flattening the rotary input does not remove the mismatch, because the rank-4 tensor originates upstream in the conv stack.
reexport_blocker.missing_prerequisite: onnxscript, required by the torch 2.13 dynamo exporter that this model does trace with; or a graph rewrite that eliminates the rank-4 conv output. Neither can be installed or written without new authority.
reexport_blocker.consequence: Moonshine cross-attention cannot be projected from this encoder, so long-form windowing, streaming and per-fixture seeds stay blocked. The port keeps the checkpoint seed cache and therefore keeps passing.
